newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers 3.5 trillion lire of CTZs.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers 3.5 trillion lire of CTZs.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it was offering 2.0 trillion lire of two-year zero-couponed certficiates (CTZ) and 1.5 trillion lire of 18-month CTZs at auction.
The Treasury said the 18-month CTZ offer would be a third tranche offering of December 30, 1998 stock and the 24 month offer a first tranche of July 15, 1999 stock.
Bids must be presented by 1100 GMT on July 10. The auction will be held on July 15.
